name: io.github.DeepCivic/au-privacy-review
title: Australian privacy review (APPs)
description: Review a project for privacy issues under the Australian Privacy Principles. Not legal advice.

runtimeArguments.name: -v
runtimeArguments.description: The folder to review, mounted read-only at /work. Ask for a review of /work.

project_dir.description: Absolute path of the project (repository and documents) to review

environmentVariables.name: AU_PRIVACY_REVIEW_LIVE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to enable probe_deployment, which fetches a public URL and its privacy policy. Off by default.
